data.narrative:
Stegra operates in the Climate & Energy sector at Growth stage, having raised $7.0B+ to date. The comparable universe includes one public peer (LNZA) and eight private companies spanning advanced energy, materials, and critical minerals—including Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen. However, the private comp set lacks sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage peers with directly comparable valuation tiers to support a reliable peer-median approach; a sector-wide median would risk obscuring material differences in technology maturity and commercial trajectory.

Stage-progression analysis, the sole applicable triangulation method given data constraints, employs a 1.2x step-up multiplier applied to the $7.0B total-raised proxy, yielding an implied valuation of $8.4B. This multiplier reflects typical Growth-stage advancement to the subsequent funding round or exit-ready phase, absent company-specific operational or market metrics to warrant material deviation.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $7.1B to $9.7B (median $8.4B), anchored to stage-based progression. Key uncertainties include the absence of granular revenue, EBITDA, or unit economics data; the thin comparable set of truly peer-equivalent private transactions; and Stegra's specific technology commercialization timeline relative to sector peers. Additional fundamental diligence on customer concentration, production capacity, and capital requirements would be necessary to narrow this range or adjust the applied multiplier.
